# Rukn Al Zain General Trading LLC

> Rukn Al Zain General Trading LLC is a Dubai-based supplier of heavy-duty recycled-rubber flooring for the UAE and GCC. Products cover three segments: acoustic rubber underlay for construction, gym and fitness rubber flooring, and animal and agricultural rubber mats and pavers. Deliveries serve all seven emirates: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Umm Al Quwain and Fujairah.

Contact: Rukn Al Zain General Trading LLC, P.O. Box 36528, Dubai, UAE. Phone / WhatsApp: +971505698195 (https://wa.me/971505698195). Quotes and free sample kits are available on request.

## Acoustic Rubber Underlay

- [Acoustic Underlay & Soundproof Flooring](https://ruknalzain.ae/acoustic-soundproofing-flooring): Category hub for impact sound insulation in high-rises and commercial projects
- [Acoustic Underlay (ZainAcoustic)](https://ruknalzain.ae/acoustic-underlay): Impact sound insulation underlayment beneath marble, tile, engineered wood and vinyl
- [Sports Track Underlay (Zain Prime)](https://ruknalzain.ae/sports-track-underlay): Rubber underlay for sports tracks and surfaces
- [Screed Isolation (ZainSilence)](https://ruknalzain.ae/screed-isolation): Rubber isolation mat laid under floor screed
- [Acoustic Strips (Zain Acoustic Strip)](https://ruknalzain.ae/acoustic-strips): Self-adhesive perimeter and decking isolation strips

## Gym & Fitness Flooring

- [Gym & Fitness Flooring](https://ruknalzain.ae/gym-fitness-flooring): Category hub for commercial and home gym rubber flooring
- [Rubber Gym Tiles](https://ruknalzain.ae/rubber-gym-tiles): Tile range overview
- [ZainFit](https://ruknalzain.ae/rubber-gym-tiles/zainfit): Rubber gym tile
- [ZainSquare](https://ruknalzain.ae/rubber-gym-tiles/zainsquare): Rubber gym tile
- [Zain Extreme](https://ruknalzain.ae/rubber-gym-tiles/zainextreme): Heavy-duty gym flooring
- [Gym Flooring Rolls](https://ruknalzain.ae/gym-flooring-rolls): Continuous SBR and EPDM rubber rolls
- [ZainActive Rolls](https://ruknalzain.ae/gym-flooring-rolls/zainactive-rolls): Rubber gym roll
- [ZainDuo](https://ruknalzain.ae/gym-flooring-rolls/zainduo): Duo performance roll system
- [Gym Safety Accessories](https://ruknalzain.ae/gym-safety-accessories): Equipment and wall protection
- [Zain Curb Stone](https://ruknalzain.ae/gym-safety-accessories/curb-stone): Impact-absorbing curb stones protecting glass, mirrors and equipment

## Animal & Agricultural Flooring

- [Animal & Agricultural Flooring](https://ruknalzain.ae/animal-agricultural-flooring): Category hub for horse stables, dairy farms and animal enclosures
- [Zain Horse Mat](https://ruknalzain.ae/horse-mats): Non-slip rubber mats for horse stables
- [Zain Hammer Top](https://ruknalzain.ae/hammer-top): Rubber mats for dairy farms
- [Outdoor Pavers](https://ruknalzain.ae/outdoor-pavers): Interlocking rubber pavers for gardens and animal areas
- [Zain Dog Bone Pavers](https://ruknalzain.ae/outdoor-pavers/dogbone): Interlocking dog bone rubber pavers
